Lochia.6: Deffir tuyat, lochia d asuffeɣ n tgellit yeqqnen d usirem amagnu n tfelwit n ugris. Initen-is d yimḍan-is ttbeddilen s leḥnana deg wussan d wayyuren i d-yetteddun.
Lochia.10: D acu izemren ad yili d amagnu
Lochia.12: Melmi ara tsuter tamawt n umusnaw?
Lochia.15: Lochia d asuffeɣ n tgellit i d-yettbanen deffir tuyat. Yettwaxdem s wudem amatu seg tuffɣa n idammen, n yiferrawen d n iẓuran n tfelwit mi ara tettwaslaḥ.
Lochia.16: Ur yemṣada ara d lḥiḍ amagnu. D ayen yettwarǧa deg wakud n deffir tuyat u s wudem amatu yettunqes s leḥnana.
Lochia.18: Lochia ur tebbi ara belli lḥiḍ-ik yuɣal yakan. Tuɣalin n lḥiḍ d ayen yemgaraden i d-yeḍran mbeɛd.
Lochia.19: 2. Amek i yettbeddil lochia s wakud?
Lochia.20: Tamuɣli-ines tettbeddil s wudem amatu deg yimalas imezwura. Inin yettuɣal d aceqqaq s leḥnana u ddmiḍ yettnaqes.
Lochia.22: Iswiren zemrent ad mgaraden seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ
Lochia.25: Asuffeɣ yettili s wudem amatu d azeggaɣ u yezmer ad yili d ameqqran ugar deg tazwara.
Lochia.28: Inin yettuɣal d aceqqaq s leḥnana u yezmer ad yuɣal d axuxi neɣ d aberkan.
Lochia.31: Asuffeɣ yettuɣal d aceqqaq, d awlalaw neɣ d amellal, uqbel ad yeqqim.
Lochia.32: 3. D acu izemren ad yili d amagnu
Lochia.33: Abeddel n lochia ur yemṣada ara s wudem ummid i yal yiwet. Kra n yisenfal zemrent ad d-ddint s wudem amagnu d usirem deffir tuyat.
Lochia.35: Tallelt tezmer ad tbeddel deg wussan imezwura, sakin ad tennaqes s leḥnana.
Lochia.37: Lochia tettṛuḥ s wudem amatu seg uzeggaɣ ɣer yiniten yeḍfuren s wakud.
Lochia.39: Tezmer ad teqqim kra n yimalas, u abeddel-is yemgarad seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ.
Lochia.41: Deg wakud-a, ɛass fessus yezmer ad k-yeɛawen ad twalid amek i yettbeddil ugris-ik war ma tmegrdeḍ tarmit-ik d tin n wayeḍ.
Lochia.43: Fren asizdeg s leḥnana, s lḥal, war tisabunin ara k-yeččaren.
Lochia.45: Tzemreḍ ad taruḍ inin, ddmiḍ d ubeddel n usuffeɣ ma yella aya yeɛawen ad tɛassed asirem-ik.
Lochia.47: Deffir tuyat yeṭṭef akud. Sel i ugris-ik u ḥrem ilaq-is n usirem.
Lochia.49: Lochia tettban deg wussan deffir tuyat u tettunqes s leḥnana. Tuɣalin n lḥiḍ, deg ubrid-nniḍen, d ayen yeqqnen d usnulfu n uzray n lḥiḍ-ik mbeɛd akud-a.
Lochia.51: Asuffeɣ yeqqnen d usirem n tfelwit deffir tuyat.
Lochia.53: Asnulfu n uzray n lḥiḍ, deg wakud yemgaraden seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ.
Lochia.54: 6. Melmi ara tsuter tamawt n umusnaw?
Lochia.55: Ma yella abeddel-is yettban-ak d ayen ur nelli ara d amagnu, neɣ ma yella waddad-ik amatu yettemcer, d ayen yesɛan azal ad tsuteḍ tamawt n umusnaw n tezmert.
Lochia.57: Tgemmunt tazurant neɣ ur nelli ara d tamagnut
Lochia.59: Azray i d-yuɣalen ameqqran s tuffirt
Lochia.60: Aṭṭan ameqqran, yettṛajun neɣ ur nelli ara d amagnu
Lochia.63: Lochia tettbeddil s leḥnana: tezmer ad tili d tazeggaɣt deg tazwara, sakin ad tuɣal d taceqqaqt uqbel ad teqqim. Maca, asirem n yal yiwet yemgarad.
Lochia.65: Lochia d asuffeɣ amagnu deffir tuyat.
Lochia.66: Tettbeddil s wudem amatu deg yinin d ddmiḍ deg yimalas.
Lochia.67: Akud-is d ubeddel-is zemrent ad mgaraden seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ.
Lochia.68: Tagemmunt ur nelli ara d tamagnut, taḥmi, aṭṭan ameqqran, neɣ azray ameqqran d amazzal ssutrent tamawt n umusnaw.
Lochia.69: Agbur n isallen. Amagrad-a ur yettnefsu ara tamawt n umusnaw neɣ asenqed. Ma tettwaṭṭfeḍ s ccek neɣ ma twalid tizmilt i k-yeččaren, suter tamawt n umusnaw n tezmert.

MedicalExams.6: Ultrasound d yisenqden yesɛan azal, trimestre ɣer trimestre.
MedicalExams.13: Tigzi tesɛa s wudem amatu kraḍ n ultrasound imeqqranen, yiwen i yal trimestre, yal yiwen s wuswir yemgaraden.
MedicalExams.14: Trimestre amezwaru: tarikt n zzman d yimmal n tɣuri n ɣer ṭṭerf (nuchal)
MedicalExams.15: Trimestre wis sin: ultrasound n tmuɣli n ugris
MedicalExams.16: Trimestre wis kraḍ: ugar d wadeg n ubrid n lweldun
MedicalExams.17: Isenqden n idammen s lḥal ttɛassen aṭas n yimdanen yesɛan azal deg tegzi:
MedicalExams.18: Aswir n uzzar, i usnerni n uɣbel yezmer ad d-yili
MedicalExams.19: Asenqed n ssukkar n tigzi, s wudem amatu ɣer trimestre wis sin
MedicalExams.20: Tagrupt n idammen d usenqed n tgemmunt ur nelli ara d tamagnut
MedicalExams.21: Isenqden n serology (toxoplasmose, rubéole) almend n waddad-ik n tgellit
MedicalExams.22: Aru isteqsiyen-ik akken ara d-ttaffeḍ-tent, uqbel ad tettuɣalen tettuɣaleḍ
MedicalExams.23: Awi adlis-ik n udfar n tigzi ɣer yal asmekti
MedicalExams.24: Ɛiwen yal tizmilt tamaynut, ɣas ma tettban-d d tamecṭuḥt
MedicalExams.25: Uṭṭun n yisenqden d tfelwit-nsen zemrent ad mgaraden almend n uɛawen-ik, n lxaṭar-ik, d tarrayin n tmurt-ik neɣ n win i k-yettɛawnen.
MedicalExams.27: Ur tɛerrageḍ ara ad tarud isteqsiyen-ik uqbel yal asmekti akken ur tettuɣaleḍ ara kra: ulac asteqsi yecṭuḥ aṭas akken ad ttwasteqsin.
MedicalExams.28: Tafelwit n yisenqden n tigzi — AWA

MenopauseHormones.6: Mi ara yeqreb ménopause, iḥormonen-ik ur ttwaqeṭṭaɛen ara d tikkelt: ttbeddilen, ayen ara d-yeǧǧen abeddel n uzray d tuget n tizmilin yemgaraden.
MenopauseHormones.9: D acu i d-yeḍran deg perimenopause?
MenopauseHormones.19: D acu n tifrat zemrent ad ttwasumren?
MenopauseHormones.21: Kraḍ n yiḥormonen imeqqranen ttbeddilen deg usenfar-a, yal yiwen s wawal-is:
MenopauseHormones.23: Yesɛa aẓar ɣef uzray, uglim, iɣsan, wul, u yettḥekkim cwiṭ deg tuyaḍ d tikli.
MenopauseHormones.25: Yettwaxdem mbeɛd ovulation, ɣur-s tazmert tamellalt kra u yeheyyi ugris i tigzi ara d-yeḍren.
MenopauseHormones.27: Uwengez yettḥekkim fell-asen, ssenzadan iwtilen; aswiren-nsen ttbeddilen mi ara d-ttarran iwtilen s wudem yemgaraden.
MenopauseHormones.29: Aswiren n iḥormonen ur ttnaqqasen ara s wudem aderɣal deg perimenopause: zemrent ad ttbeddilent, ad d-ttalint u ad ttarwent, uqbel ad stestqerrent deg uswir ibrikan mbeɛd ménopause.
MenopauseHormones.30: Iwtilen ttarran drus drus s wudem n yiwen kan i yimeslayen n iḥormonen i d-yettazen uwengez. Aya i d-yesbedden azray ur yelli ara d amagnu u yefkak acimi tizmilin zemrent ad mgaraden seg yiwen ayyur ɣer wayeḍ.
MenopauseHormones.32: D ayen yezmer ad tḥessseḍ tizmilin yettbanen deg yiwen n wayyur, sakin ulac-iten amzun deg wayeḍ. Aya ur yelli ara d ayen ur nelli ara d amagnu: yesbeggen kan abeddel n iḥormonen n wakud-a.
MenopauseHormones.33: Isenfal n estrogène zemrent ad qqnent d kra n yisenfal:
MenopauseHormones.40: Tizmilin-a zemrent ad sɛint isebbaben yemgaraden: ur qqnent ara dima d iḥormonen, u tazmert-nsent temgarad aṭas seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ.
MenopauseHormones.41: Progestérone ttwaxdem kan mbeɛd ovulation. Maca deg perimenopause, ovulation d iman-is tuɣal tettbeddil ugar — ayen i d-yeǧǧen taxdamt-is tettemcer.
MenopauseHormones.42: Aya yessefhem cwiṭ isenfal i d-yettbanen deg uzray: aswir yemgaraden, lḥiḍ kra tikwal d ameqqran neɣ d amecṭuḥ ugar n zik.
MenopauseHormones.43: Beṛṛa n yisenfal n iḥormonen, aṭas n wayen-nniḍen ittekkin: tazmert n tuyaḍ, aswir n usari, tudert, d lefruq i yellan di yal yiwet.
MenopauseHormones.44: “Yal tamttut tettɛedday deg usenfar-a s wudem yemgaraden.”
MenopauseHormones.45: Izray ur nelli ara d imagnuyen
MenopauseHormones.54: Umuɣ-a d isallen kan: ur yelli ara d aselmed n wanaṭṭan. Yal yiwet tettɛedday deg ujmuɛ yemgaraden n yisenfal-a.
MenopauseHormones.55: Tidi n yiḍ zemrent ad d-ssegzint tuyaḍ, ayen i d-yeǧǧen taɛyiwt d ukkaḍ n usnuddem n wass i d-yetteddun — d lmeɛna i yettili aṭas deg wakud-a.
MenopauseHormones.57: Taxxamt tazeggwaɣt, ilebsen yeḥfafen, d tikli n tuyaḍ yestqerrin zemrent ad ssenqsent tuffɣa-a.
MenopauseHormones.58: Isenfal n iḥormonen zemrent ad msawaḍen d isenfal n tikli, war ma d ssebba kan: tuyaḍ, asari, isenfal n tudert, d tizmilin n ugris ttekkin daɣen.
MenopauseHormones.60: Ma tḥessseḍ iman-ik ugar d tunnaḍt deg wakud-a, ur yebbi ara belli yella kra ur nelli ara d amagnu: d tarmit tamatut i izemren ad tesɛu aṭas n isebbaben.
MenopauseHormones.61: Aswiren n iḥormonen zemrent ad mgaraden aṭas seg yiwen n wass ɣer wayeḍ deg perimenopause. Asenqed yiwen ur d-yettak ara dima tamuɣli tummidt ɣef waddad.
MenopauseHormones.63: Asenqed n tezmert yettwabna s wudem amatu ɣef leɛmer-ik, tizmilin-ik, d umezruy n uzray-ik — ur yelli ara kan ɣef yiwen n wuṭṭun.
MenopauseHormones.64: Ma tarud ayen i tettɛeddiḍ ayyur ɣer wayeḍ, ad k-yeɛawen ad twalid tikli-ik tamagnut war ma tmegrdeḍ iman-ik d wiyaḍ:
MenopauseHormones.71: Ayen yettban-d yekkes kra n tizmilin
MenopauseHormones.73: Ma tɛasseḍ azray-ik deg AWA, ad k-yeɛawen ad twalid tikli-ik tamagnut deg wayyuren, war aɛdim.
MenopauseHormones.74: Aṭas n waddaden-a ssutrent asenqed amagnu, s lḥal-ik:
MenopauseHormones.75: Yelha ad tmeslayeḍ fell-as d umusnaw
MenopauseHormones.76: Tizmilin ɛekkunt tudert-ik n yal ass s wudem ameqqran
MenopauseHormones.79: Tizmilt tamaynut neɣ ur nelli ara d tamagnut
MenopauseHormones.82: Uguren n uɣaṛ n tgellit neɣ n tudert-ik tuffirt
MenopauseHormones.84: Azray ameqqran aṭas neɣ ur nelli ara d amagnu, deg ubrid-nniḍen, ilaq ad d-yettwabder s uzrir ɣer umusnaw n tezmert.
MenopauseHormones.85: Almend n waddad, amusnaw yezmer ad d-yemmal tifrat yemgaraden:
MenopauseHormones.87: Armad aɣaṛ, tuččit, d usenfal n usari d tuyaḍ.
MenopauseHormones.89: Kra n tifrat zemrent ad nnawent tizmilin yemgaraden, almend n waddad.
MenopauseHormones.91: Yettwamyawal d ṭṭbib mi ara yemṣada d umezruy-ik d wayen tḥewwjeḍ.
MenopauseHormones.92: Ifranen-a qqimen d udmawan: ttwabnan ɣef umezruy-ik, tizmilin-ik, lxaṭar, d wayen tebɣiḍ.
MenopauseHormones.93: Isenfal n iḥormonen d aɣerwaḍ ibanen n usenfar ɣer ménopause.
MenopauseHormones.94: Aswiren n iḥormonen zemrent ad ttbeddilent aṭas deg perimenopause, war unqis aderɣal.
MenopauseHormones.95: Tizmilin mgaraden aṭas seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ, d seg yiwen ayyur ɣer wayeḍ.
MenopauseHormones.96: Ma tɛasseḍ tizmilin-ik, ad k-yeɛawen ad twalid ugar tikli-ik tamagnut.
MenopauseHormones.97: Amusnaw n tezmert yezmer ad k-yeɛawen ma yuɣal yeɛya ad tɛeddiḍ deg tizmilin.
MenopauseHormones.98: Agbur n isallen. Amagrad-a ur yettnefsu ara amusnaw n tezmert i yiman-ik. Ma tettwaṭṭfeḍ s ccek, nadi ɣef lemɛawna i umusnaw n tezmert.

MenopauseTransition.6: D acu ibeddlen s leḥnana, iseggasen uqbel ad ɛekkun izray, d amek ara tkecmeḍ ɣer uswir-a s tmuɣli tafessast ugar.
MenopauseTransition.9: Izray ur nelli ara d imagnuyen ugar d ugar
MenopauseTransition.11: Tudert tuffirt d uɣaṛ n tgellit
MenopauseTransition.13: Tiktiwin ur nelli ara d tisaḍnin ɣef ménopause
MenopauseTransition.14: Tizmilin timagnuyin d tamezwarut ara twalid
MenopauseTransition.18: Perimenopause d akud n usenfar n iḥormonen i yettwabdan uqbel ménopause: yezmer ad yebdu kra n yiseggasen uqbel, s wudem amatu seg tmeṛṛa n iseggasen, mi ara ttbeddilent aswiren n estrogène s wudem ur nelli ara d amagnu.
MenopauseTransition.19: Ménopause, deg ubrid-nniḍen, d lawan ibanen: yettwabeggen mbeɛd 12 n wayyuren yettemcaren war lḥiḍ, war ssebba-nniḍen. Deg Fransa, tettili s wudem amatu ɣer leɛmer n 51 n iseggasen, maca leɛmer-a yemgarad s wudem amagnu seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ.
MenopauseTransition.21: Yal tamttut tettɛedday deg usenfar-a s wudem yemgaraden, deg wakud d tazmert n tizmilin. Tameslayt ɣef waya s lḥal tettak-ak-d tallelt ad tt-tessneḍ uqbel.
MenopauseTransition.22: 2. Izray ur nelli ara d imagnuyen ugar d ugar
MenopauseTransition.23: Yiwen seg yimezwura n tizmilin n perimenopause d abeddel n tikli n uzray: izray zemrent ad uɣalen d imecṭuḥen, d iseggwanen, d ibaɛden, neɣ s uzray yemgaraden seg yiwen ayyur ɣer wayeḍ.
MenopauseTransition.25: Azray ameqqran aṭas, azray i d-yeḍran qrib aṭas, neɣ azray i d-yeḍran mbeɛd useggas war lḥiḍ ssutrent tamawt n umusnaw, acku ur ttwaḥsaben ara d tizmilin imagnuyen n usenfar.
MenopauseTransition.27: Unqis d usenfal n estrogène d progestérone zemrent ad ssenfalent tuyaḍ (tuyaḍ n tazwara, ussenyef deg yiḍ) u zemrent ad ddint d usari, ukkaḍ, neɣ isenfal n tikli ur nelli ara d imagnuyen.
MenopauseTransition.28: Isenfal-a sɛan tifrat n tbyolujit tideț: ur d-ttbeggnen ara ulac n tuffirt n ulawi, neɣ ugur n tkunwit weḥd-s.
MenopauseTransition.29: 4. Tudert tuffirt d uɣaṛ n tgellit
MenopauseTransition.30: Unqis n estrogène yezmer ad d-yeǧǧ aɣaṛ n tgellit, kra tikwal d wulawi neɣ aṭṭan deg tudert tuffirt. Tebɣest tezmer daɣen ad tbeddel, ad tt-tneḥreḍ neɣ ad tt-tnaqseḍ, almend n tmettut.
MenopauseTransition.32: Llan tifrat fessusen (lubrifiants, imiqqasen n tgellit, ddwa n wadeg): tameslayt d umusnaw n tezmert tezmer ad k-yeɛawen ad tafeḍ tifrat ilaqen, war tabu.
MenopauseTransition.34: Lmetabolisme yezmer ad iqqim cwiṭ deg wakud-a, u usuffeɣ n tfelwit yettwali ad iddu ɣer uɣaṛ. Isenfal-a d imatuten u ur sɛin ara ssebba n tuyaḍ kan.
MenopauseTransition.35: 6. Tiktiwin ur nelli ara d tisaḍnin ɣef ménopause
MenopauseTransition.36: Ménopause “tettili d tikkelt” — s tidet, tettwazwar sɣur aṭas n yiseggasen n usenfar (perimenopause)
MenopauseTransition.37: Tizmilin akk d timeqqranin i yal yiwet — tazmert-nsent temgarad aṭas seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ
MenopauseTransition.38: Ulac ayen izemren ad yettwaxdem — llan aṭas n tifrat, s iḥormonen neɣ war iḥormonen, i usefsu n tizmilin yeččuren
MenopauseTransition.39: Tudert tuffirt tettwaqqen — tettbeddil, maca tezmer ad tili tameqqrant u d tameǧǧuht s yisenfal ilaqen
MenopauseTransition.40: 7. Tizmilin timagnuyin d tamezwarut ara twalid
MenopauseTransition.41: Tuget n yisenfal i d-yettwabeggen dagi d timagnuyin n usenfar. Maca, kra n tizmilin ssutrent tamawt n umusnaw s uzrir.
MenopauseTransition.43: Azray mbeɛd ménopause yettwabeggnen, aṭṭan ur nelli ara d amagnu deg uɣaṛ n tmeẓẓit, tizmilin ɛekkunt tudert n yal ass s wudem ameqqran, neɣ ccek yettṛajun.
MenopauseTransition.45: Tuččit teččuren s calcium d fibres
MenopauseTransition.48: Iseqqaren n lehna n yal ass
MenopauseTransition.51: Perimenopause d ménopause d iswiren imagnuyen, ur d-llin ara d aṭṭan. Llan aṭas n tifrat i k-yeɛawnen ad tɛeddiḍ deg usenfar-a s lehna ugar: amusnaw n tezmert yeqqim d win i k-yeqqnen akk akken ad tent-yessawaḍ ɣer waddad-ik.

MenopauseTreatments.6: Ddwa n usenfal n iḥormonen d tifrat war iḥormonen, akken ad theyyiḍ tameslayt d ṭṭbib-ik.
MenopauseTreatments.8: Ddwa n usenfal n iḥormonen n ménopause
MenopauseTreatments.13: Ddwa n usenfal n iḥormonen n ménopause (THM) yettaǧǧa unqis n estrogène u izmer ad yessefsu tizmilin yeččuren akk, am tiḥemmi, uguren n tuyaḍ, neɣ aɣaṛ n tgellit.
MenopauseTreatments.14: THM izmer daɣen ad yeɛawen deg uḥerz n uɣrab n yiɣsan. Maca, ur yelhi ara i yal waddad: amezruy udmawan n kra n waddaden (aṭṭan n wul d yisurifen, kra n yimeṭṭi yeqqnen d iḥormonen) izmer ad yessenqes aseqdec-is.
MenopauseTreatments.16: Amiḍan n lfayda d lxaṭar n THM yettwabna ɣef leɛmer-ik, melmi i yebda ɣer ménopause, d umezruy-ik udmawan n tezmert: asenqed udmawan n tezmert ilaq uqbel yal ccek.
MenopauseTreatments.17: Mi ara ur tebɣiḍ ara THM neɣ mi ara ur ilhi ara, llan tifrat-nniḍen i usefsu n tizmilin:
MenopauseTreatments.18: Ddwa n tikli d tmeɣrust (i uzzeggeg n usari d tuyaḍ)
MenopauseTreatments.19: Ddwa s tilawin n tmura, s tamawt n umusnaw n tezmert
MenopauseTreatments.20: Isenfal n tudert (tuččit, armad aɣaṛ, tuyaḍ)
MenopauseTreatments.21: Lubrifiants d imiqqasen n tgellit i uɣaṛ n tgellit
MenopauseTreatments.23: Ɣas ddwa s tilawin n tmura yesɛa azal ad d-tsutreḍ tamawt n umusnaw: “d ayen n tmeslayt” ur yebbi ara “war tmsalin ara d-yeḍren” d ddwa-nniḍen.
MenopauseTreatments.24: Ma theyyiḍ kra n tmeṛṛiwin uqbel asmekti, ad k-yeɛawen ad tɛemmreḍ tameslayt:
MenopauseTreatments.25: Tizmilin-ik yeččuren aṭas n yal ass
MenopauseTreatments.26: Amezruy-ik udmawan d wa n twacult n tezmert
MenopauseTreatments.27: Ayen tḥemmleḍ (s iḥormonen neɣ war iḥormonen, acḥal n wakud i tettxemmimeḍ)
MenopauseTreatments.28: Isteqsiyen-ik d wayen i k-yeččaren — ur tɛerrageḍ ara ad ten-tsuteḍ
MenopauseTreatments.30: S iḥormonen neɣ war iḥormonen, ulac ddwa yelhan i yal yiwen: ayen i k-ihwan yettwabna ɣef waddad-ik udmawan, ittwasenqed d umusnaw n tezmert.

MenstruationPurity.6: Fehm azeṭṭa gar uzray d waddad n ṭṭhara n ddin, akken ad tkecmeḍ ɣer wakud-a s tmuɣli tafessast ugar.
MenstruationPurity.8: Agbur-a d ameslaw kan. Isteqsiyen n ddin ilaq ad ttwasenqed sɣur ineɛlamen yettwaslen. AWA ur d-yettaf ara fatwa neɣ ugdud n ddin i yal yiwen.
MenstruationPurity.14: D acu ara txedmeḍ ma tettwaṭṭfeḍ s ccek?
MenstruationPurity.16: Deg ddin n Lislam, ṭṭhara tebbi waddad ilaqen i kra n ttaɛebbudt, am ṣṣlat. Ur tebbi ara ṭṭhara n yal ass, maca waddad yettwassnen deg fiqh, ibeddlen almend n iswiren n uzray n tmettut.
MenstruationPurity.17: Deg lḥiḍ, tamttut tettwakkes-as kra n ttaɛebbudt, nezzeh ṣṣlat d ṣṣyam n Ramaḍan, ara d-tzedmeḍ mbeɛd. Ukkes-a yettwassen d lxfif, ur yelli ara d ɛeqbet.
MenstruationPurity.18: D acu i d-yeqqimen deg lḥiḍ
MenstruationPurity.20: Ssel neɣ ɣer agbur n isallen d wagbur n ddin
MenstruationPurity.21: Tallelt n ṭṭaɛebbudt n wid i k-yeqqnen
MenstruationPurity.24: Kra n tfesriwin (am tɣuri taɣelnawt n Lqur’an neɣ ukcum ɣer lǧameɛ) zemrent ad mgaraden almend n tmedrest n fiqh; yelha ad tuɣaleḍ ɣer tmedrest i tettṭafareḍ neɣ ɣer unaɛlam yettwaslen i waya.
MenstruationPurity.25: Taggara n lḥiḍ tebbi tuɣalin s leḥnana ɣer ṭṭhara. S tmuɣli n ugris, aya yemṣada d wesbaḍ n uzray, ayen izemren tmedresin n fiqh ad t-sbeggnent s lefruq imecṭuḥen.
MenstruationPurity.27: Ma tfehmeḍ iswiren n uzray, ad k-yeɛawen ad tafeḍ ddmiḍ ideg ara yekfu lḥiḍ s tidet.
MenstruationPurity.28: Mi ara twalid aɛalam-a, ghusl (lɣusl ameqqran) ad k-yeǧǧ ad tuɣaleḍ ɣer ṭṭhara u ad tkemmleḍ ttaɛebbudt yettwaḥbesen.
MenstruationPurity.29: Ghusl d lɣusl n ddin ameqqran i d-ssutren asizdeg n ugris meṛṛa s tuɣalin n lniya n ṭṭhara. Yebbi taggara n ukkes u ad ṣṣlat tuɣal d tamagnut, war ma d ilaq ad tzedmeḍ ṣṣlawat i d-yezwar deg lḥiḍ.
MenstruationPurity.31: Amek i yettwaxdem ghusl s wudem ṣaḥiḥ izmer ad yemgarad cwiṭ almend n tmedrest n fiqh i tettṭafareḍ.
MenstruationPurity.33: Ma tessneḍ ara iswiren ṣaḥiḥ n tmedrest-ik, win i tettamneḍ neɣ anaɛlam yettwaslen ad ak-ten-yessiweḍ s tefessast.
MenstruationPurity.34: D ayen amagnu ad tḥessseḍ ccek ɣef wakud n taggara n lḥiḍ, nezzeh mi ara yenqes azray s leḥnana war ma yebbi ad yeqqim d tikkelt.
MenstruationPurity.36: Ɛass ma yella azray yeqqim d ulac, ur yelli ara kan yenqes
MenstruationPurity.37: Eǧǧ akud yekfan uqbel ad tbanedeḍ belli lḥiḍ yekfa
MenstruationPurity.38: Ṭṭef deg uɛass ayen d-yeḍran ɣef kan tarmit
MenstruationPurity.39: Ḥseb tikli-ik tamagnut, i izemren ad tmgarad seg yiwen uzray ɣer wayeḍ
MenstruationPurity.41: Deg waddaden n uzray yettṛajun neɣ ur nelli ara d amagnu, neɣ ccek yettṛajun, tilawin-a ilaq ad ttwasmeslayent d unaɛlam yettwaslen, ara k-yesbeggen almend n waddad-ik udmawan. Agbur-a yeqqim d isallen kan u ur yettnefsu ara asebbeggen udmawan n ddin.
MenstruationPurity.43: Yialamen-a d asmekti amatu n lmelma. Yal waddad yezmer ad yesɛu timeẓlayin-is: ma tettwaṭṭfeḍ s ccek, tameslayt d unaɛlam yettwaslen tettqim d ayen i yelhan akk akken ad tafeḍ tiririt i k-ihwan.

MiscarriageFertility.13: Tayerza tettuɣal s wudem amatu seg uzray i d-yetteddun mbeɛd tuqqna tamezwarut n tigzi. Ovulation tezmer ad tt-ḍru uqbel ad d-yuɣal lḥiḍ-ik s wudem ibanen.
MiscarriageFertility.15: Almend n uswir n tuqqna, akud n usirem n tfelwit izmer ad yemgarad cwiṭ seg yiwet n tmeslayt ɣer tayeḍ.

MiscarriageFertility.18: Tayerza ttuɣal s tazzla, seg uzray i d-yetteddun.
MiscarriageFertility.20: Akud ɣezzifen cwiṭ n usirem izmer ad yettwaqbel sɣur tarbaɛt n tezmert.
MiscarriageFertility.21: Aḥsas yeheyya, deg ugris d wul, yeqqim d ubrid ameqqran akk — ugar n yal akud n tidet.
MiscarriageFertility.23: Aḥsas yeheyya deg wul-ik yesɛa azal am usirem n ugris.
MiscarriageFertility.25: Azray amagnu d lḥal n lehna d icerṭen yelhan.

MiscarriageFertility.36: Tuqqna yiwet kan s wudem amatu ur tebbi ara ugur n tyerza. Tarbaɛt-ik n tezmert tettqim d tin yelhan akk i teglen isteqsiyen-ik udmawanen.
